end.summary:
Practised diversity in Indian languages, food, dress and festivals.
Gave examples including Pongal, Bihu, Lohri, Makar Sankranti and regional clothing.
Identified shared threads through Diwali, harvest festivals and seasonal customs.
Explained that different Makar Sankranti traditions share a winter-season connection.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Riya practised comparing regional differences and finding common ideas beneath them. They used festival examples and explained that different Makar Sankranti customs can share the same winter season; an initial uncertainty about the shared thread was clarified later in the lesson (correctAfterLastSeen). At home, ask Riya to make a two-column list of one regional difference and one shared idea for three festivals.
